description: The intersection-crossing study authors publish scenarios supporting partially observable trajectory planning. Zenodo supplies a small dataset archive free under CC BY 4.0 and identifies Lanelet2 map inputs. The linked primary study uses real aerial observations at two intersections to examine how uncertain measurements affect an adaptive-belief-tree planner. These materials can support scenario preparation and comparisons of intersection-crossing simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this release. Geographic coverage is the two study intersections; the public summary does not establish their full coordinates or observation dates. Scenario selection and measurement assumptions limit transfer to other junctions, and exact trajectory formats or sample counts were not verified. The archive is not evidence of a separately reusable planning implementation. No files were downloaded or planner executed.
